_doc: kind = dash | arc | multi_arc | projectile | homing | stream | beam | aoe_self | aoe_target | zone | self_buff | debuff_aoe | clones. category = physical | special | status. Times in seconds, distances in metres. PP: 'uses' = PP of the move in the main series; PP cost = 100 / uses (so a 100 PP pool gives exactly that many uses). Fatigue (stamina bar) is a log-linear curve over 'uses' alone (5 -> 50, 10 -> 35, 40 -> 10), flat below 5 and above 40; a move with no 'uses' falls back to 10 x PP cost. Override with 'pp_cost' / 'fatigue'. If a move pushes stamina below 0 the user is staggered for 2 s. Accuracy: 'accuracy' in % (as in the games; omitted = never misses, e.g. Swift). On a failed roll auto-aimed moves are physically thrown off target (projectiles/beam/dash/swipes go wide, area strikes land 2-3 m away) and can't damage the aimed target. Homing, aoe_self, stream and stat moves never miss. Cooldown (per move, stops spamming the same move) = windup + duration + fatigue/40, minimum 2 s for status moves, rounded to 0.1 s. Set 'cooldown' on a move to override. If 'allowed_midair' is false the move cannot be started by a fighter that is in the air (it travels the body along the ground: every kind 'dash' move) and waits for landing; absent = true. A stream with "once": true keeps its cone and duration but damages each target at most once per cast; a target that enters the cone later still takes that one hit (Gust, Sand Attack). "slam": true on a ground aoe_self makes the user crouch, leap (~1.5-2x a normal hop) and slam down, with the aoe/damage resolving on the landing frame instead of at cast (D108); Magnitude scales its jump and impact with the roll. Cut: Mud Sport and the Victreebel stockpile/spit_up/swallow trio have no delivery kind; every other FRLG level-up move up to Lv25 exists. N02: absorb/mega_drain/leech_life fire a green homing orb ("drain": 0.5, turn 2.0 so a dodge is possible) and, on connect only, heal the user for half the damage dealt with a green stream flowing target -> user; sludge lobs ("fx": "lob", 2.2 m arc); self_destruct is an aoe_self that faints the user; charge/growth are single-stat self_buffs (both Sp. Atk here); minimize sets the same evasion as Double Team; encore is a Speed -1 debuff (no repeat-lock mechanic).

moves.name: Tackle
moves.desc: A physical attack in which the user charges, full body, into the foe.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.desc: An almost invisibly fast attack that is certain to strike first.

moves.name: Scratch
moves.desc: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe.

moves.name: Bite
moves.desc: The user bites with vicious fangs. It may make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Thief
moves.desc: The user attacks and steals its held item simultaneously. No held items exist yet, so it is a plain dark hit.

moves.name: Fury Swipes
moves.desc: The foe is raked with sharp claws or scythes two to five times.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.desc: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the foe two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Ember
moves.desc: The foe is attacked with small flames. The foe may suffer a burn.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.desc: The foe is struck with a lot of water expelled forcibly from the mouth.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.desc: An electric shock attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Razor Leaf
moves.desc: The foe is hit with a cutting leaf. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.desc: A seed is planted on the foe to steal some HP for the user on every turn.

moves.name: Swift
moves.desc: Star-shaped rays that never miss are fired at all foes in battle.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.desc: The foe is scorched with intense flames. The foe may suffer a burn.

moves.name: Gust
moves.desc: Strikes the foe with a gust of wind whipped up by wings.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.desc: A severely damaging attack that makes the user rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.desc: An earthquake that strikes all POKéMON in battle excluding the user.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.desc: A brutal lightning attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.desc: A sleep-inducing dust is scattered in high volume around a foe.

moves.name: Poison Powder
moves.desc: A cloud of toxic dust is scattered. It may poison the foe.

moves.name: Growl
moves.desc: The user growls in a cute way, making the foe lower its ATTACK stat.

moves.name: Tail Whip
moves.desc: The user wags its tail cutely, making the foe lower its DEFENSE stat.

moves.name: Harden
moves.desc: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its DEFENSE stat.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.desc: The user creates illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.desc: An extremely fast attack against one target. It can't be evaded.

moves.name: Bind
moves.desc: A long body or tentacles are used to bind the foe for two to five turns.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.desc: The user drops its full body on the foe. It may leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Bubble
moves.desc: A spray of bubbles hits the foe. It may lower the foe's SPEED stat.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.desc: A weak telekinetic attack that may also leave the foe confused.

moves.name: Curse
moves.desc: A move that works differently for the GHOST-type and all the other types.

moves.name: Defense Curl
moves.desc: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its DEFENSE stat.

moves.name: Dig
moves.desc: An attack that hits on the 2nd turn. Can also be used to exit dungeons.

moves.name: Disable
moves.desc: For a few turns, it prevents the foe from using the move it last used.

moves.name: Double Kick
moves.desc: Two legs are used to quickly kick the foe twice in one turn.

moves.name: Double Slap
moves.desc: The foe is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times.

moves.name: Dragon Rage
moves.desc: The foe is hit with a shock wave that always inflicts 40-HP damage.

moves.name: Flail
moves.desc: A desperate attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.desc: The user takes a deep breath and focuses to raise its critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Fury Attack
moves.desc: The foe is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times.

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.desc: The user exhales a heated breath to attack. It may also inflict a burn.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.desc: A move that boosts the power of the ally's attack in a battle.

moves.name: Horn Attack
moves.desc: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

moves.name: Hyper Fang
moves.desc: The foe is attacked with sharp fangs. It may make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.desc: Hypnotic suggestion is used to make the foe fall into a deep sleep.

moves.name: Karate Chop
moves.desc: The foe is attacked with a sharp chop. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Leer
moves.desc: The foe is given an intimidating look that lowers its DEFENSE stat.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.desc: A low, tripping kick that inflicts more damage on heavier foes.

moves.name: Magnitude
moves.desc: A ground-shaking attack against all standing POKéMON. Its power varies.

moves.name: Metal Claw
moves.desc: The foe is attacked with steel claws. It may also raise the user's ATTACK.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.desc: Mud is hurled in the foe's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Peck
moves.desc: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.desc: The foe is stabbed with a toxic barb, etc. It may poison the foe.

moves.name: Pursuit
moves.desc: An attack move that works especially well on a foe that is switching out.

moves.name: Rage
moves.desc: An attack that becomes stronger each time the user is hit in battle.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.desc: A heavy rain falls for five turns, powering up WATER-type moves.

moves.name: Rapid Spin
moves.desc: An attack that frees the user from BIND, WRAP, LEECH SEED, and SPIKES.

moves.name: Rock Throw
moves.desc: The foe is attacked with a shower of small, easily thrown rocks.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.desc: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe's SPEED if it hits.

moves.name: Sand Attack
moves.desc: A lot of sand is hurled in the foe's face, reducing its accuracy.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.desc: Frightens the foe with a scary face to sharply reduce its SPEED.

moves.name: Screech
moves.desc: An ear-splitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe's DEFENSE.

moves.name: Slam
moves.desc: The foe is struck with a long tail, vines, etc.

moves.name: Slash
moves.desc: The foe is slashed with claws, etc. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Smokescreen
moves.desc: An obscuring cloud of smoke or ink reduces the foe's accuracy.

moves.name: Splash
moves.desc: The user just flops and splashes around without having any effect.

moves.name: String Shot
moves.desc: The foe is bound with strings shot from the mouth to reduce its SPEED.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.desc: Paralyzing dust is scattered wildly. It may paralyze the foe.

moves.name: Submission
moves.desc: A reckless, full-body throw attack that also hurts the user a little.

moves.name: Supersonic
moves.desc: The user generates odd sound waves. It may confuse the foe.

moves.name: Sweet Scent
moves.desc: Allures the foe to reduce evasiveness. It also attracts wild POKéMON.

moves.name: Thrash
moves.desc: The user rampages about for two to three turns, then becomes confused.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.desc: A weak electric shock that is sure to cause paralysis if it hits.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.desc: A strong electrical attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.desc: A simultaneous 3-beam attack that may paralyze, burn, or freeze the foe.

moves.name: Twineedle
moves.desc: The foe is stabbed twice with foreleg stingers. It may poison the foe.

moves.name: Vine Whip
moves.desc: The foe is struck with slender, whip-like vines.

moves.name: Water Sport
moves.desc: Weakens FIRE-type attacks while the user is in the battle.

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.desc: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.

moves.name: Wing Attack
moves.desc: The foe is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide.

moves.name: Withdraw
moves.desc: The user withdraws its body in its hard shell, raising its DEFENSE stat.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.desc: A huge yawn lulls the foe into falling asleep on the next turn.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.desc: The foe is slammed with a sturdy tail of iron. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Fire Fang
moves.desc: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also leave the foe burned.

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.desc: The user lunges at the foe at a speed almost impossible to dodge.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.desc: The foe is hit with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

moves.name: Skull Bash
moves.desc: The user tucks in its head and charges the foe with a skull bash.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.desc: Large boulders are hurled at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.desc: The user rolls into the foe, gathering speed with each hit.

moves.name: Cross Chop
moves.desc: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Seismic Toss
moves.desc: The foe is thrown using the power of gravity.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.desc: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the foe.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.desc: The user strikes the foe with a sudden jab before it can react.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.desc: The user crunches up the foe with sharp fangs. It may also lower the foe's DEFENSE.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.desc: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Dragon Breath
moves.desc: The foe is hit with a powerful breath of dragon energy. It may also paralyze.

moves.name: Twister
moves.desc: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Volt Tackle
moves.desc: The user electrifies its body and crashes into the foe with full force.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.desc: The user hurls an electric orb at the foe. The faster the user is, the greater the damage.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.desc: The user chomps hard on the foe with its sharp front fangs.

moves.name: Drill Peck
moves.desc: A corkscrewing attack with the beak acting as a drill.

moves.name: Drill Run
moves.desc: The user crashes into the foe while rotating its body like a drill.

moves.name: Crush Claw
moves.desc: The user slashes the foe with hard claws. It may also lower the foe's DEFENSE.

moves.name: Sand Tomb
moves.desc: The user traps the foe inside a harshly raging sandstorm for several turns.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.desc: The foe is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Bubble Beam
moves.desc: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the foe. It may also lower the foe's SPEED.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.desc: The user fights the foe up close without guarding itself.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.desc: The user swings its tail like a wave to strike the foe.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.desc: The user wraps the foe in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. It may also confuse the foe.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.desc: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.desc: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the foe burned.

moves.name: Dragon Claw
moves.desc: The user slashes the foe with sharp claws.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.desc: The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

moves.name: Petal Dance
moves.desc: The user attacks the foe by scattering a storm of sharp petals.

moves.name: Megahorn
moves.desc: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the foe with no letup.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.desc: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. It may poison the foe.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.desc: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the foe's Sp. Def.

moves.name: Pin Missile
moves.desc: Sharp spikes are shot at the foe in rapid succession.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.desc: The foe is attacked with a peculiar ray. It may also leave the foe confused.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.desc: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the foe's Sp. Def.
